advancing: combat depth → fleet/base command → offline PvE endgame.

## 2. Current feature map (from PROJECT_MAP.md)

- New pure mechanic (waves, flooding, ballistics, scoring math) → `js/core.js` + a test first.
- New gameplay (weapon, ship class, shop item, FX) → `js/game.js`, constants in `TUNES`/`WEAPONS`.
- Keep `index.html` IDs stable (`startBtn`, `hud`, `minimap`, …); the smoke test depends on them.
- World height always comes from `waveRaw`/`waveScaled`, never a second formula.
- Admin multipliers stay last in every scaling chain.

## 3. Roadmap (prioritized)

- [x] **P0 Gates** — `node tools/gates.mjs`, npm-free, with smoke autostart.
- [x] **P0 Orders** — touch parity, transactional purchases, per-run reset.
- [ ] **P1 Endgame economy tuning** — verify hull/escort/registry costs stay
      meaningful after every patch; playtest each balance change.
- [ ] **P1 Ship purchase expansion** — unlock carrier purchases + per-ship
      plane loadouts (bombs, ammo stock, upgrade time + cost scaling).
- [ ] **P2 Enemy adaptation** — bosses get drones once the player fleet is maxed
      (`adaptTier` already caps; add drone support to enemies).
- [ ] **P2 Boss multi-encounters** — real simultaneous boss groups when the
      player owns a full fleet.
- [ ] **P3 Base/command mode** — plan where the fleet goes, send orders from a
      home base.
- [ ] **P3 Multiplayer (future)** — WebSocket/SFU, replay friendly.

## 4. Bugs risk register

- Allocation per frame in FX if not cached — three.js docs warn about GC.
- Water shader parity: JS `waveRaw` must stay identical to the GLSL copy.
- Admin dev multiplication MUST stay last in every scaling chain (FIX #21).
- Any `_PLACEHOLDER_` in code or docs means an unbuilt feature — grep before release.

## 5. Tooling workflow

- Run: `node tools/gates.mjs` → `node tools/counters.mjs --check`.
- Never kill global node — only the exact child processes you spawned.
- Keep `docs/plan.md` and `docs/error-report.md` current after each session.
